title: aster hyssopifolius var. rigidulus
intro: Aster hyssopifolius var. rigidulus, commonly known as stiff aster, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The stiff aster is said to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
